title: Granular block-smoothing and refund guardrails for enterprise trials
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Problem: Enterprise customers on trial or onboarding reserved capacity frequently trigger unpredictable invoice spikes due to: (a) transient background retries and long-running batch jobs, (b) seat/commit reallocation mid-cycle, and (c) multi-stage security questionnaire holds where customers request provisional credits while we finish SSO/KMS onboarding. These spikes cause support volume, distrust, and delayed contract closes.

Goal: Run a controlled experiment and implement a pragmatic product + ops surface that smooths short-window metering spikes (block smoothing), provides clear UI guardrails for refund/provisional-credit workflows, and produces an auditable ledger for post-invoice reconciliations. The solution should reduce false overages by >= 65% for trial accounts and cut manual billing disputes by 40% for enterprise onboarding flows.

Scope:
- Behavioral change for hosted API and Dedicated meter aggregation (do not change raw token counts stored in analytics; introduce billing-layer smoothing/windowing + reconciliation).
- Console UI: provisional credit request flow, automated note on invoices for smoothed-samples, and reconciliation task link for billing ops.
- Billing ops runbook and automated scripts to reverse/pro-rate when customer transitions between reserved and pay-as-you-go mid-cycle.
- Experiment-only rollout for 8 weeks with telemetry and dashboarding.

Out of scope: Changes to accounting recognition rules; formal GA contract amendments (handled by Finance/legal).
acceptance_criteria: Smoothing algorithm reduces invoice overage incidents for trials by >= 65% in the 8-week experiment window (measured via billing-dispute tag)
Console exposes a clear provisional credit request with required security questionnaire link and estimated credit amount before invoice generation
Billing ops team can run a one-click reconciliation to convert smoothed credits into ledger entries with full audit trail
Automated notification (email + Console banner) is sent to customers when a provisional credit is applied or reversed
No change in raw telemetry metrics stored in analytics; smoothing is strictly applied in billing pipeline and reversible for audits
tasks: Design smoothing algorithm: implement time-windowed block smoothing (default window = 6h, with per-customer multiplier) - spec: https://confluence.redwood.ai/billing/block-smoothing-spec (draft)
Implement billing-layer smoothing in billing-worker (ENG-22461) and add feature flag experiment: billing.block_smoothing.experiment_PM-128450
Add provisional credit request flow to Console: wire up form, attach security-questionnaire state, and link to escrow notes
Create billing ops runbook and Playbook entry: reversible ledger adjustments, approval gating, and GL mapping
Instrument dashboards: dispute-rate, smoothed-amounts, false-positive overages, per-customer trial cohort (dashboard link: https://dashboards.redwood.ai/billing/PM-128450)
Legal/Finance review: capture required fields for accounting and escalate any recognition questions
QA: test scenarios - retry storms, seat deallocation mid-cycle, security-questionnaire hold -> credit flow
Ship experiment with a staged rollout: 2% customers -> 10% -> 30% -> 100% for trial cohorts if KPIs meet thresholds
